diagnosis.reference: On the firewall fw-ext, ruleset OUTSIDE-TO-DMZ is detached from the zone pair OUTSIDE to DMZ, so that traffic falls to the default deny.

commands: set nat source rule 105 outbound-interface name 'eth4'
set nat source rule 105 source address '10.10.40.0/24'
set nat source rule 105 translation address 'masquerade'
changes.reason: Public validation shows only web1<->external1 ICMP fails while internal<->DMZ paths succeed; fw-ext has OUTSIDE/DMZ policy allowing the ICMP both directions, but NAT lacks any source masquerade rule for DMZ subnet 10.10.40.0/24, so replies from web1 to external1 are sent with unroutable private source.

commands: set nat destination rule 11 inbound-interface name 'eth4'
set nat destination rule 11 translation address '10.10.40.10'
changes.reason: After adding missing DMZ source NAT, public validation still shows only external1<->web1 ICMP failing while all other allowed paths pass. fw-ext outside-to-dmz firewall explicitly permits ICMP to 10.10.40.10 from 203.0.113.10, but destination NAT publishes web1 only for TCP/80, so pings to 203.0.113.1 are not translated to web1.

action.command:
set nat source rule 105 description 'dmz-web-masquerade'
set nat source rule 105 outbound-interface name 'eth4'
set nat source rule 105 source address '10.10.40.0/24'
set nat source rule 105 translation address 'masquerade'
